title: Fragrant Traybaked Carrot & Ginger Soup
description: Carrots, onion, ginger and garlic roasted on a tray with orange zest and juice, then blended with stock into a smooth, fragrant soup.
ingredients: 1 tbsp peeled and finely chopped fresh ginger
finely grated zest and juice of 1 medium orange
steps: Add onion, ginger, garlic, carrots and orange zest and juice to a deep baking tray; mix well; spray with cooking spray. Roast on middle shelf 30 minutes.
Reduce oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Remove tray; stir vegetables; pour in stock.
Return to oven for another 30 minutes.
Blend until smooth with a hand blender; add salt.
Serve with pepper ground on top and scattered with parsley.
notes: Use the back of a teaspoon to scrape ginger skin off easily.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
